title: Hot Season Hair Care: Protect & Shine
summary: Sun, sweat and dust pull moisture out of hair fast. A simple routine to keep it soft through the heat.
body:
Strong sun, heat and dust can be harsh on your hair. UV rays and sweat strip away moisture, leaving strands dry and brittle.

## Hydrate, hydrate, hydrate

Just like your skin, your hair needs extra hydration in the heat. Switch to a moisturizing shampoo and conditioner, and don't skip the leave-in.
